prompts.causeway_steps: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production game sprite, an isolated low stone stair threshold for a medieval 26-pixel-grid RPG matching Stoneshard's restrained hand-painted pixel art. Primary request: a short worn grey limestone causeway stair, three shallow stone treads descending toward the bottom of the image, with two low broken coping stones at its sides. It lies flat on the ground and is viewed from a high overhead three-quarter RPG camera; horizontal edges remain horizontal, no isometric diamond. All of it fits a compact wide 52 by 39 native-pixel footprint, shown enlarged with deliberate hard pixel clusters and no outlines thicker than one native pixel. Muted weathered grey/beige stone, small moss specks, dark crevice between treads, subtle directional daylight upper left, no glow. No upright door, no standing door frame, no roof, no wall, no ground rectangle, no people, no text, no surrounding scene, no border, no cast shadow extending outside the sprite. Center the whole single stair on a truly transparent background with ample transparent padding. Keep the visual simple and readable when reduced to 52x39 pixels; no fine photographic grain or antialiasing.
